rationale.text: The page has a select, but no optgroup anywhere. The test asks something of each optgroup in a select, and the methodology starts from the lists that have optgroup elements; with none, there is nothing the test applies to. The custom check answers inapplicable, and the entry's applicability is structural, so the finding is not_applicable at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. Whether these options should have been grouped is test 11.8.1.
